$comment: The docs site's Vercel project has Root Directory `website`, so this file
is where its build is configured.
`buildCommand` exists because the site lists `nuxt-convex-module` as a
workspace dependency and loads it as a Nuxt module. pnpm links the
repository root into node_modules, but the link points at a package whose
`dist/` is gitignored — so on a fresh clone `nuxt build` fails at module
resolution before it renders a single page:
[warn]  The module `nuxt-convex-module` could not be loaded.
Building the module first is the whole fix. The root `build` script is used
rather than `dev:prepare:lib` deliberately: the stub symlinks dist/runtime
at src/, which is a development shape, and this is a production deploy.
Preview deployments get NO Convex environment variables — not a convention
but the mechanism: with no `CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY` in the environment, `convex
deploy` cannot run on a preview even if something later tries to call it.
buildCommand: pnpm --dir .. run build && pnpm exec nuxt build
